title: WOLFBORN
synopsis: A mother hides her wolf-born twin from her hunter husband, keeping a secret by the ice river.

audienceReactions.quote: I hope they make movie or series about this, it is so incredibly good.
audienceReactions.author: YouTube viewer

audienceReactions.quote: Watching from Trinidad and Tobago, I love this emotional wolf family story.
audienceReactions.author: YouTube viewer

audienceReactions.quote: Mother remains mother, only mother can love child no matter who they are.
audienceReactions.author: YouTube viewer
